name: scraper_project
description: This folder contains the tooling that collects product reviews, walks through pagination, and saves the results in JSONL/CSV form for later analysis. The project includes a tiny synthetic catalogue so the pipeline can be exercised without touching the network, plus CLI switches for real-world runs.

scripts.resume_help:
node -e "console.log('Resume examples:
- node collection_auto_rawData.js --resume-run=<runId>
- node collection_auto_rawData.js --resume-run=<runId> --concurrency=4
- node collection_auto_rawData.js --resume-run=<runId> --categories=mobilya
- node collection_auto_rawData.js --resume-run=<runId> --products=734699208,734700038')"
scripts.failed_help:
node -e "console.log('Failed-run examples:
- node collection_auto_rawData.js --failed-only
- node collection_auto_rawData.js --failed-only --concurrency=4
- node collection_auto_rawData.js --failed-only --name=my-failed-run
- node collection_auto_rawData.js --failed-only --failed-file=logs/failed_jobs_latest.json')"
scripts.named_run_help:
node -e "console.log('Named run examples:
- node collection_auto_rawData.js --name=my-run
- node collection_auto_rawData.js --name=my-run --categories=mobilya
- node collection_auto_rawData.js --name=my-run --products=734699208,734700038
- node collection_auto_rawData.js --name=my-run --categories=mobilya --concurrency=4')"
